payout_quote: Opportunity to earn up to $300 for participating in study about distress in daily life! ... Compensation is up to $300 for completing the entire study. You will get $20 for each lab visit, $20 for completing measures at home, and up to $240 for responding to the app prompts on your phone for three weeks, where you must complete 85% of the notifications to receive full payment.
steps: Open the TEMPT Lab 'Study Distress in Daily Life' page on tempt.uark.edu
Confirm adult eligibility and ability to visit the U of A lab twice + reliable internet/smartphone
Fill out the linked screening measure
If eligible, complete the first lab visit (questionnaires, install the app)
Respond to phone app prompts several times per day for three weeks (85% completion required for full payment)
Complete the second lab visit (emotion skills training) and online home measures to earn up to $300
catches: Pay is 'up to' $300 with no stated floor; partial completion earns less
Must complete 85% of phone notifications to receive full payment
Requires two in-person visits at the University of Arkansas (Fayetteville)
Requires reliable internet and a smartphone for three weeks of daily prompts
Full payment spread over ~six weeks of participation
Payment method (cash/check/gift card) not stated on the page
biggest_catch: 'Up to $300' is heavily conditional — $240 of it requires 85% completion of daily phone prompts over three weeks, with no stated floor for partial completion.
eligibility: Adults (18+); able to visit the TEMPT Lab at the University of Arkansas (Fayetteville) twice; reliable internet service and smartphone for the app prompts.
timing: ~6 weeks of involvement; ~10 hours active (2 hours in lab + ~1 hour home measures + <7 hours of brief phone prompts). Payment timing not stated.
